property_summary: For every input, calling transfer with an empty _tos array causes the reference C to revert (so the call does not return true), whereas the mutant removes that precondition and thus returns true for some inputs with empty _tos; the test asserts that transfer MUST revert when _tos is empty.
change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) precondition with a no-op so the function allows empty _tos and returns true, changing behavior for empty arrays.
